"When working on Next.js projects, I need to check..."

**For a new agent:**

**For an enhancement:**
- Current behavior: ...

Any alternative solutions you've thought about.

## Framework/Context
- Framework(s) this applies to: [e.g., all, Eleventy only, Next.js, etc.]

- [ ] I'd like to implement this myself

Any other information, examples, or references.
